name: Defiance AI Hyperscale Leaders ETF
desc: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing (directly or indirectly) in U.S.-listed equity securities of companies that the Adviser believes are leaders in enabling, developing, or benefiting from the hyper-scaling of artificial intelligence (“AI”) computing infrastructure to efficiently train, deploy, and run complex AI models by demonstrating strong scalability, positive revenue growth and profitability. It is non-diversified.
